resetWarning: Reset replaces this demo’s requirements, cases, owned source and run history. Active runs or tasks block reset. Other projects are preserved.
noRequirement: No requirement yet. Define intent and acceptance criteria first.
coverageGapCount: {{count}} design or automation coverage gaps remain.
executionMeaning: Execution and pass counts reflect the latest actual bound test results, not unexecuted or subsequently edited code.
contextKept: Current project and entity context retained
invalidStructuredOutput: The AI response did not pass structured requirement analysis validation. Jev was not run and no analysis was applied. Check that the configured model supports JSON output, then retry.
referenceNotice: This is human-authored demo reference material, not a completed AI/Jev invocation. Start analysis to call the configured services.
decisionEvidence: Selection is grounded in linked risks and acceptance criteria.
localFallback: Local fallback; no Jev success claimed.
noAnalysis: No analysis recorded. Add explicit acceptance criteria first.
designIntent: Scenarios organize intent, risk, coverage and oracles. Adoption reuses existing designs.
truncated: Projection limit reached; partial results are shown. Incomplete data cannot claim complete coverage.
noGraphMatches: No matching nodes. Clear the search or filter.
panHint: Drag to pan, or focus the canvas and use arrow keys. Select a node to inspect its sources.
sourceRelationships: Relationships come from persisted entities and real executions.
coverageBasis: Design coverage uses actual AC/rule/risk/flow references. Automation uses active bindings; execution and pass coverage use the latest actual pytest results. Unknown denominators display —.
noDenominator: No valid denominator; 100% coverage cannot be claimed.
dataSource: Data persisted on this case. Automation should load and verify it through project fixtures.
draftNotVerified: Data, actions and oracles are present. Generated code still requires review and real execution.
noRun: Run a test to view its actual live browser and results here.
noTelemetry: No events of this kind were captured.
previewNotice: This is an interactive local shop preview. Run frames come from the actual test browser.
selectCase: No case is linked to the current file. Execution results will still be saved.
noSourceFile: Select a test file before running.
staleAnalysis: Requirement inputs changed. Reanalyze; previous conclusions are historical.
